plan.title: Turn on SIM lock (port-out PIN) with your carrier
plan.note: Top single leverage point. Cuts 9 downstream account takeover chains.
plan.why: Enabling a carrier port-out PIN prevents unauthorized SIM swapping and blocks phone OTP takeover.

plan.title: Use a unique password for each of: Netflix, Hotmail, Amazon, OldForum
plan.note: Worth 4.1 alone, 3.4 after SIM lock. Separates high-value accounts from stale breached services.
plan.why: Stops credential stuffing between low-security legacy forums and active shopping/banking vaults.

plan.title: Revoke 'email_inbox:gmail' permission from AI Photo Studio Pro
plan.note: Quick win: High risk reduction with zero daily workflow friction.
plan.why: Third-party photo editing app does not require full read/write access to your primary Google inbox.

plan.title: Upgrade Gmail 2FA to Hardware Security Key (FIDO2)
plan.note: Worth 3.8 alone, 1.2 after SIM lock. SIM lock already protects against phone OTP intercept.
plan.why: Eliminates phishing susceptibility across the central identity hub for Google SSO accounts.

plan.title: Remove stale Hotmail backup email from Dropbox Cloud Vault
plan.note: Eliminates stale bridge from unmonitored legacy mailbox to confidential files.
plan.why: Hotmail has been inactive since 2022; if abandoned, an attacker could hijack Dropbox reset tokens.

plan.title: Delete unused account: DevSec Enthusiast Forum
plan.note: Reduces attack surface by eliminating legacy forgotten credential dump targets.
plan.why: Account has had no recorded activity since 2019.

plan.title: Remove SMS OTP direct login from Amazon
plan.why: Enforces app authenticator login instead of interception-prone SMS.

plan.title: Use unique passwords for Instagram and Canva (Group B)
plan.note: Decouples design assets from social media exposure.
plan.why: Separates social credentials from design tooling.
